name: Fixed-Sized Buckets for Isosurface Extraction
definition: A method for active cell determination in isosurface extraction that uses fixed-sized buckets to sort cells by intensity ranges, offering small memory footprint and average-case optimality.
summary: Fixed-Sized Buckets is an output-optimal isosurface extraction algorithm that uses a logical 2D array to sort cells by intensity, avoiding tree traversal overhead for accelerated performance.
